body:
After some debugging I've found the issue. It's related to the way `src` attribute is obtained from `iframe` and after altering the returned value `'iframe.html?id=*&viewMode=story'` to `http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=*&viewMode=story` Storybook started to work as normal.

#### Root problem

`var src = frame.getAttribute('src')` returns source but it's stripped from base url and that's why `new URL(src)` throws an error.

```js
var src = frame.getAttribute('src') // 'iframe.html?id=*&viewMode=story'
new URL(src) // TypeError: Failed to construct 'URL': Invalid URL
```

#### Possible solution:

A. switch from `frame.getAttribute('src')` to just `frame.src`
```js
var src = frame.src // 'http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=*&viewMode=story'
```

B. pass additional base to URL constructor like `new URL(src, base)`
```js
var base = 'http://localhost:6006/'
var src = frame.getAttribute('src') // 'iframe.html?id=*&viewMode=story'
new URL(src, base)
```

issue.title: Static Storybook doesn't load in Firefox or Safari due to `TypeError: Invalid scheme`

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Using `Storybook@6.0.12` the static storybook from `yarn build-storybook` works in Chrome, but does not load in Firefox or Safari. 

Firefox: `TypeError: URL constructor: null/{...}storybook-repro-repo/storybook-static/iframe.html is not a valid URL.`

Safari: `TypeError: Invalid scheme`

The storybook loads, but the iframe containg the story stays at the loading state:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1231321/90444537-dadd3a80-e092-11ea-8699-b78f85bc5267.png)



**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1.) Build storybook `yarn build-storybook`
2.) Open output `static-storybook/index.html` in a browser other than Chrome.
3.) Stories do not load; console has error.

Made a repo using `npx sb init` that has this issue: https://github.com/codycoats/storybook-repro-repo

**Expected behavior**
Expect static storybook to load.

**System:**
```
❯ npx sb@next info

Environment Info:
  System:
    OS: macOS 10.15.6
    CPU: (8) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8279U CPU @ 2.40GHz
  Binaries:
    Node: 10.21.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v10.21.0/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.4 - /usr/local/bin/yarn
    npm: 6.14.4 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v10.21.0/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Chrome: 84.0.4147.125
    Safari: 13.1.2
  npmPackages:
    @storybook/addon-actions: ^6.0.12 => 6.0.12 
    @storybook/addon-essentials: ^6.0.12 => 6.0.12 
    @storybook/addon-links: ^6.0.12 => 6.0.12 
    @storybook/react: ^6.0.12 => 6.0.12 
```

**Additional context**
Found a similar issue https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/10227 but it was not for the static output.
